manuallyManagedDependencies.rationale: Pinned to 5.9.2 across the monorepo by .syncpackrc.json; automated bumps must move the coordinated pin.

Pinned across the monorepo by .syncpackrc.json so every build resolves the same prebuilt addon. Since 13.x the package is N-API and ships its binaries in the tarball with no install script, so the pin is about reproducibility, not about matching an ABI. 13.x also requires Node >= 22.14 (WiseLibs/better-sqlite3#1514): moving the pin means re-running the install smoke across the Node floor and every platform.
OpenTUI upgrades require controlled render, PTY, and performance validation.
Must move with @opentui/core after the same controlled render, PTY, and performance validation.
Seed clustering and deterministic labels depend on parser stability; upgrades require rerunning canonical history fixtures and idempotency checks.
